description: 令和3年度静岡市主要交差点交通量調査結果 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 静岡市. 静岡市内の主要交差点における自動車の方向別交通量や渋滞長、また、歩行者や自転車の通行量を調査することにより、道路交通状況を把握するとともに、交通計画（都市計画、道路計画等）の基礎資料や道路事業の評価・分析を行うことを目的に交通量調査を実施している。. Coverage: 静岡市. The portal files it under the publisher 静岡市. Its tags are 交通, 交通量. It offers 3 resource(s) in zip. The portal shows 2025-06-13 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
